en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large neo‑Gothic brick complex seen from across a tree‑lined street. The central block has pointed‑arch windows in several stories, decorative brick gables with pinnacles, and a tall flagpole flying a plain flag. A monumental pointed arch gateway in matching brick leads through a forecourt in the middle of an iron fence; people are visible walking near the gate and under the arch. The long wings of the building extend left and right in the same style, giving the impression of a major institutional building such as a barracks, school, or hospital.
